summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) announcing a US$10 million registered direct offering to Unusual Machines and an unnamed leading U.S. investment fund, each contributing US$5 million. The deal comprises 1,869,159 common shares at US$5.35 per share, priced at-market to the September 25, 2026 close, with gross proceeds before placement fees. Jett Capital Advisors and Northland Capital Markets serve as joint-lead placement agents. Closing is expected on or about September 29, 2026, subject to customary conditions and Canadian Securities Exchange approval. This is a routine capital-raising, not a special situation; watch for prospectus supplement filing and share overhang.
